chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, he elevated it to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'The woman does not give birth for less than six months.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib)

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum duration of pregnancy according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam Ali (peace be upon him), recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, establishes the minimum biological gestation period as six months, a foundational metric in Shia jurisprudence for determining the validity of birth and the onset of specific legal statuses. This ruling serves as a critical reference point in discussions regarding *haidh* (menstruation) and *nifas* (postpartum bleeding), ensuring that legal obligations such as prayer and fasting are correctly applied based on physiological reality.
